**10. Portfolio Direction?**

BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.04% | 1M: -5.62%), China/EM (FXI/EEM) remain vulnerable.

BEARISH: Copper CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -2.28%) and gas volatility (UNG RECOVERY (1W: +7.16% | 1M: -27.34%)) merits caution.

VXX 20 (volatility trigger), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF 2.0 (style pivot), SPY 1M support zone (monitor index downside).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive.  
Energy showing relative strength — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.58% | 1M: +10.71%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.86% | 1M: +17.18%).  
Key risk is rising volatility via VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.98% | 1M: +10.84%) against SPY/QQQ BELOW TREND — watch for volatility spikes and credit signal flickers.
